meta.title: Villains and Vigilantes
meta.description: With a cunning blend of gossip and omens foretold, she deceives the newcomer with a mix of new and old.

units.rawText: Shopping street, still under construction.
units.displayText: Shopping street, still under construction.

spans.text: Shopping street, still under construction.

units.rawText: Flower shops, snacks, vaudeville... what is all of this? Not a hint of originality here.
units.displayText: Flower shops, snacks, vaudeville... what is all of this? Not a hint of originality here.

spans.text: Flower shops, snacks, vaudeville... what is all of this? Not a hint of originality here.

units.rawText: Hm? This is intriguing... let's see, a black-colored robe, sunglasses, a big stick... and a banner with writing on it?
units.displayText: Hm? This is intriguing... let's see, a black-colored robe, sunglasses, a big stick... and a banner with writing on it?

spans.text: Hm? This is intriguing... let's see, a black-colored robe, sunglasses, a big stick... and a banner with writing on it?

units.rawText: The upright discerner of truths... this is a damn fortune teller stall?
units.displayText: The upright discerner of truths... this is a damn fortune teller stall?

spans.text: The upright discerner of truths... this is a damn fortune teller stall?

units.rawText: Unacceptable! Why in the world was my request rejected when something as ludicrous as this made it in?!
units.displayText: Unacceptable! Why in the world was my request rejected when something as ludicrous as this made it in?!

spans.text: Unacceptable! Why in the world was my request rejected when something as ludicrous as this made it in?!

units.rawText: This is bloody agent discrimination! My idea was way more interesting than this nonsense!
units.displayText: This is bloody agent discrimination! My idea was way more interesting than this nonsense!

spans.text: This is bloody agent discrimination! My idea was way more interesting than this nonsense!

units.rawText: She sits herself at the still-incomplete stall, beginning to fiddle with her camera.
units.displayText: She sits herself at the still-incomplete stall, beginning to fiddle with her camera.

spans.text: She sits herself at the still-incomplete stall, beginning to fiddle with her camera.

units.rawText: That pisses me right off! If they said my idea wasn't allowed under the guidelines, then whatever, but something as silly as a fortune telling stall made it in...
units.displayText: That pisses me right off! If they said my idea wasn't allowed under the guidelines, then whatever, but something as silly as a fortune telling stall made it in...

spans.text: That pisses me right off! If they said my idea wasn't allowed under the guidelines, then whatever, but something as silly as a fortune telling stall made it in...

units.rawText: Ah! The green creature! This is that vomit-green thing's stall! Ahh, Professor! The humanity!
units.displayText: Ah! The green creature! This is that vomit-green thing's stall! Ahh, Professor! The humanity!

spans.text: Ah! The green creature! This is that vomit-green thing's stall! Ahh, Professor! The humanity!

units.rawText: Kuro seethes at the mysteriously smiling photograph on the wall. Not too far away, heavy footsteps can be heard.
units.displayText: Kuro seethes at the mysteriously smiling photograph on the wall. Not too far away, heavy footsteps can be heard.

spans.text: Kuro seethes at the mysteriously smiling photograph on the wall. Not too far away, heavy footsteps can be heard.

units.rawText: That sound came from over here, right?
units.displayText: That sound came from over here, right?

spans.text: That sound came from over here, right?

units.rawText: Looks like your wishes will have some solid footing soon with how fast we're finding these interlopers.
units.displayText: Looks like your wishes will have some solid footing soon with how fast we're finding these interlopers.

spans.text: Looks like your wishes will have some solid footing soon with how fast we're finding these interlopers.

units.rawText: Seriously, why does it always happen when I'm about to start streaming? I've gotta leg it again...
units.displayText: Seriously, why does it always happen when I'm about to start streaming? I've gotta leg it again...

spans.text: Seriously, why does it always happen when I'm about to start streaming? I've gotta leg it again...

units.rawText: No, wait, look at the bigger picture... hehe, I've got an idea.
units.displayText: No, wait, look at the bigger picture... hehe, I've got an idea.

spans.text: No, wait, look at the bigger picture... hehe, I've got an idea.

units.rawText: This is the commercial district, no? There's a lot of variety with the stalls around here.
units.displayText: This is the commercial district, no? There's a lot of variety with the stalls around here.

spans.text: This is the commercial district, no? There's a lot of variety with the stalls around here.

units.rawText: I remember seeing a notice recruiting stall hosts on the forums, but I never knew this many people had signed up. Hehe, I can't wait to stroll around here with sis.
units.displayText: I remember seeing a notice recruiting stall hosts on the forums, but I never knew this many people had signed up. Hehe, I can't wait to stroll around here with sis.

spans.text: I remember seeing a notice recruiting stall hosts on the forums, but I never knew this many people had signed up. Hehe, I can't wait to stroll around here with sis.

units.rawText: So you invited Daiyan to come with you, huh?
units.displayText: So you invited Daiyan to come with you, huh?

spans.text: So you invited Daiyan to come with you, huh?

units.rawText: Well, I haven't invited her yet, since...
units.displayText: Well, I haven't invited her yet, since...

spans.text: Well, I haven't invited her yet, since...

units.rawText: The sixth line of the trigram speaks. Two trespassers come, down an alleyway...
units.displayText: The sixth line of the trigram speaks. Two trespassers come, down an alleyway...

spans.text: The sixth line of the trigram speaks. Two trespassers come, down an alleyway...

units.rawText: A sudden chant interrupts the two. Jiangyu and Aki follow the source of the sound, finding a Doll seated at a stall, dressed in the dark garb of a fortune teller.
units.displayText: A sudden chant interrupts the two. Jiangyu and Aki follow the source of the sound, finding a Doll seated at a stall, dressed in the dark garb of a fortune teller.

spans.text: A sudden chant interrupts the two. Jiangyu and Aki follow the source of the sound, finding a Doll seated at a stall, dressed in the dark garb of a fortune teller.

units.rawText: You're...
units.displayText: You're...

spans.text: You're...

units.rawText: Who goes there? Aki? Jiangyu?
units.displayText: Who goes there? Aki? Jiangyu?

spans.text: Who goes there? Aki? Jiangyu?

units.rawText: The venues are still under construction, how did you find your way in? I do not remember ever seeing your names on the staff list.
units.displayText: The venues are still under construction, how did you find your way in? I do not remember ever seeing your names on the staff list.

spans.text: The venues are still under construction, how did you find your way in? I do not remember ever seeing your names on the staff list.

units.rawText: Kuro pushes up the sunglasses she had donned at some time or another, laying her fan flat on the table in front of her.
units.displayText: Kuro pushes up the sunglasses she had donned at some time or another, laying her fan flat on the table in front of her.

spans.text: Kuro pushes up the sunglasses she had donned at some time or another, laying her fan flat on the table in front of her.

units.rawText: A kindly immortal here at the Oasis bestowed upon me the right, uhh... right...
units.displayText: A kindly immortal here at the Oasis bestowed upon me the right, uhh... right...

spans.text: A kindly immortal here at the Oasis bestowed upon me the right, uhh... right...

units.rawText: Forgetting her lines, Kuro's brows squeeze upwards as she looks towards the white banner behind her.
units.displayText: Forgetting her lines, Kuro's brows squeeze upwards as she looks towards the white banner behind her.

spans.text: Forgetting her lines, Kuro's brows squeeze upwards as she looks towards the white banner behind her.

units.rawText: ...The upright discerner of truth, with the acumen of a thousand men! Before you stands Kuro, the great sage!
units.displayText: ...The upright discerner of truth, with the acumen of a thousand men! Before you stands Kuro, the great sage!

spans.text: ...The upright discerner of truth, with the acumen of a thousand men! Before you stands Kuro, the great sage!

units.rawText: You don't seem trustworthy to me in the slightest!
units.displayText: You don't seem trustworthy to me in the slightest!

spans.text: You don't seem trustworthy to me in the slightest!

units.rawText: I'm for sure staff here, but what about you, huh? What are your identities?
units.displayText: I'm for sure staff here, but what about you, huh? What are your identities?

spans.text: I'm for sure staff here, but what about you, huh? What are your identities?

units.rawText: Uh... I... we... we're here to help! Not make trouble!
units.displayText: Uh... I... we... we're here to help! Not make trouble!

spans.text: Uh... I... we... we're here to help! Not make trouble!

units.rawText: Really? I don't believe you. I shall divine the truth.
units.displayText: Really? I don't believe you. I shall divine the truth.

spans.text: Really? I don't believe you. I shall divine the truth.

units.rawText: Kuro ostentatiously rubs the tips of her fingers together.
units.displayText: Kuro ostentatiously rubs the tips of her fingers together.

spans.text: Kuro ostentatiously rubs the tips of her fingers together.

units.rawText: The trigrams meander, and opposing signals coincide... could there truly be more at hand?
units.displayText: The trigrams meander, and opposing signals coincide... could there truly be more at hand?

spans.text: The trigrams meander, and opposing signals coincide... could there truly be more at hand?

units.rawText: Could it be that you're truly here to help?
units.displayText: Could it be that you're truly here to help?

spans.text: Could it be that you're truly here to help?

units.rawText: Yeah, really! Me and Aki just got here today. Oh, uhh... Aki, I'm not good at this stuff, you explain!
units.displayText: Yeah, really! Me and Aki just got here today. Oh, uhh... Aki, I'm not good at this stuff, you explain!

spans.text: Yeah, really! Me and Aki just got here today. Oh, uhh... Aki, I'm not good at this stuff, you explain!

units.rawText: We are here to help... but Kuro, are you really staff here?
units.displayText: We are here to help... but Kuro, are you really staff here?

spans.text: We are here to help... but Kuro, are you really staff here?

units.rawText: Something about all of this seems strange, no? Usually you...
units.displayText: Something about all of this seems strange, no? Usually you...

spans.text: Something about all of this seems strange, no? Usually you...

units.rawText: Damn!
units.displayText: Damn!

spans.text: Damn!

units.rawText: Before Aki finishes voicing his concerns, Kuro slams her fan down again, finding the right timing.
units.displayText: Before Aki finishes voicing his concerns, Kuro slams her fan down again, finding the right timing.

spans.text: Before Aki finishes voicing his concerns, Kuro slams her fan down again, finding the right timing.

units.rawText: I jumped to conclusions before. Croque told us earlier that there'd be something afoot on the ground today and that we should be careful. Something about a post someone made on the net.
units.displayText: I jumped to conclusions before. Croque told us earlier that there'd be something afoot on the ground today and that we should be careful. Something about a post someone made on the net.

spans.text: I jumped to conclusions before. Croque told us earlier that there'd be something afoot on the ground today and that we should be careful. Something about a post someone made on the net.

units.rawText: If you're here to help, then you'd better go patrol the commercial district. Who knows what troubles are just waiting for opening day to appear.
units.displayText: If you're here to help, then you'd better go patrol the commercial district. Who knows what troubles are just waiting for opening day to appear.

spans.text: If you're here to help, then you'd better go patrol the commercial district. Who knows what troubles are just waiting for opening day to appear.

units.rawText: Leave it to us! We'll dig out all the interlopers here and deliver them to justice!
units.displayText: Leave it to us! We'll dig out all the interlopers here and deliver them to justice!

spans.text: Leave it to us! We'll dig out all the interlopers here and deliver them to justice!

units.rawText: But... great sage Kuro, could you help us divine where all the bad guys are?
units.displayText: But... great sage Kuro, could you help us divine where all the bad guys are?

spans.text: But... great sage Kuro, could you help us divine where all the bad guys are?

units.rawText: Huh? Uh... mm—
units.displayText: Huh? Uh... mm—

spans.text: Huh? Uh... mm—

units.rawText: Of course! That's not a problem, give me a second.
units.displayText: Of course! That's not a problem, give me a second.

spans.text: Of course! That's not a problem, give me a second.

units.rawText: Under the pretense of organizing her tools, Kuro furiously searches for fortune-telling related information with her other hand beneath the table.
units.displayText: Under the pretense of organizing her tools, Kuro furiously searches for fortune-telling related information with her other hand beneath the table.

spans.text: Under the pretense of organizing her tools, Kuro furiously searches for fortune-telling related information with her other hand beneath the table.

units.rawText: That... something.... whatever! As the world turns beneath us, we must not, in our haste, seek that which is unattainable. A cold hand is ill fit to grasp hot food, and we must be patient with such matters.
units.displayText: That... something.... whatever! As the world turns beneath us, we must not, in our haste, seek that which is unattainable. A cold hand is ill fit to grasp hot food, and we must be patient with such matters.

spans.text: That... something.... whatever! As the world turns beneath us, we must not, in our haste, seek that which is unattainable. A cold hand is ill fit to grasp hot food, and we must be patient with such matters.

units.rawText: Miss Jiangyu, you err in your haste. Take a step back and think. If you were to sneak into the event grounds, what would your goals be?
units.displayText: Miss Jiangyu, you err in your haste. Take a step back and think. If you were to sneak into the event grounds, what would your goals be?

spans.text: Miss Jiangyu, you err in your haste. Take a step back and think. If you were to sneak into the event grounds, what would your goals be?

units.rawText: Hmm... to smash all the stalls here up?
units.displayText: Hmm... to smash all the stalls here up?

spans.text: Hmm... to smash all the stalls here up?

units.rawText: ...Don't you think that's a bit too violent?
units.displayText: ...Don't you think that's a bit too violent?

spans.text: ...Don't you think that's a bit too violent?

units.rawText: In any case, I'd advise you to go look in that direction. I don't have any other information for you.
units.displayText: In any case, I'd advise you to go look in that direction. I don't have any other information for you.

spans.text: In any case, I'd advise you to go look in that direction. I don't have any other information for you.

units.rawText: That's all we needed. Thank you, great sage!
units.displayText: That's all we needed. Thank you, great sage!

spans.text: That's all we needed. Thank you, great sage!

units.rawText: Aki, come on, let's go!
units.displayText: Aki, come on, let's go!

spans.text: Aki, come on, let's go!

units.rawText: Wait for just a second!
units.displayText: Wait for just a second!

spans.text: Wait for just a second!

units.rawText: Aki sighs resignedly, setting off to catch up to Jiangyu—not before glancing at Kuro with distrust, the latter still nonchalant and casual.
units.displayText: Aki sighs resignedly, setting off to catch up to Jiangyu—not before glancing at Kuro with distrust, the latter still nonchalant and casual.

spans.text: Aki sighs resignedly, setting off to catch up to Jiangyu—not before glancing at Kuro with distrust, the latter still nonchalant and casual.

units.rawText: Go! The festival's future is in your hands!
units.displayText: Go! The festival's future is in your hands!

spans.text: Go! The festival's future is in your hands!

units.rawText: On the other end of the street, Florence sighs as she caresses the mahjong table in front of her.
units.displayText: On the other end of the street, Florence sighs as she caresses the mahjong table in front of her.

spans.text: On the other end of the street, Florence sighs as she caresses the mahjong table in front of her.

units.rawText: To think that I prepared so many delightful mixtures for the sake of introducing some pharmaceutical fascinations to everyone...
units.displayText: To think that I prepared so many delightful mixtures for the sake of introducing some pharmaceutical fascinations to everyone...

spans.text: To think that I prepared so many delightful mixtures for the sake of introducing some pharmaceutical fascinations to everyone...

units.rawText: ...Only to pale in comparison to mahjong.
units.displayText: ...Only to pale in comparison to mahjong.

spans.text: ...Only to pale in comparison to mahjong.

units.rawText: Well, seeing as it's historically the most popular game to ever exist in the East, I can't say this loss isn't well-deserved.
units.displayText: Well, seeing as it's historically the most popular game to ever exist in the East, I can't say this loss isn't well-deserved.

spans.text: Well, seeing as it's historically the most popular game to ever exist in the East, I can't say this loss isn't well-deserved.

units.rawText: Her finger glides across the space between the mahjong tiles and the table. She sinks into thought.
units.displayText: Her finger glides across the space between the mahjong tiles and the table. She sinks into thought.

spans.text: Her finger glides across the space between the mahjong tiles and the table. She sinks into thought.

units.rawText: So, what tricks can I play here? I can hardly allow my preparations to simply go to waste.
units.displayText: So, what tricks can I play here? I can hardly allow my preparations to simply go to waste.

spans.text: So, what tricks can I play here? I can hardly allow my preparations to simply go to waste.

units.rawText: Fiddle with the tiles' face, or add a little something extra to the table? I truly am too kind to be still hesitating at a time like this.
units.displayText: Fiddle with the tiles' face, or add a little something extra to the table? I truly am too kind to be still hesitating at a time like this.

spans.text: Fiddle with the tiles' face, or add a little something extra to the table? I truly am too kind to be still hesitating at a time like this.

units.rawText: Beeeeeep—
units.displayText: Beeeeeep—

spans.text: Beeeeeep—

units.rawText: Kuro? I've already sent you all of the photos I gathered. Is there anything else? Requests that you make of people must be reasonable, you know.
units.displayText: Kuro? I've already sent you all of the photos I gathered. Is there anything else? Requests that you make of people must be reasonable, you know.

spans.text: Kuro? I've already sent you all of the photos I gathered. Is there anything else? Requests that you make of people must be reasonable, you know.

units.rawText: Hold on, what is this getup of yours? Pfft, have you truly succumbed to some loathsome disease without me at your side?
units.displayText: Hold on, what is this getup of yours? Pfft, have you truly succumbed to some loathsome disease without me at your side?

spans.text: Hold on, what is this getup of yours? Pfft, have you truly succumbed to some loathsome disease without me at your side?

units.rawText: Stop messing around. I'll have you know I'm an officially recognized truth-speaking sage.
units.displayText: Stop messing around. I'll have you know I'm an officially recognized truth-speaking sage.

spans.text: Stop messing around. I'll have you know I'm an officially recognized truth-speaking sage.

units.rawText: Alright, alright. I'll reserve a spot for you in the neural department—I'm sure you'll find that everyone else speaks in the same tongue you do.
units.displayText: Alright, alright. I'll reserve a spot for you in the neural department—I'm sure you'll find that everyone else speaks in the same tongue you do.

spans.text: Alright, alright. I'll reserve a spot for you in the neural department—I'm sure you'll find that everyone else speaks in the same tongue you do.

units.rawText: Back on topic. Jiangyu and Aki seem to have been employed by Croque as henchmen, and are looking for us all over the place.
units.displayText: Back on topic. Jiangyu and Aki seem to have been employed by Croque as henchmen, and are looking for us all over the place.

spans.text: Back on topic. Jiangyu and Aki seem to have been employed by Croque as henchmen, and are looking for us all over the place.

units.rawText: I've lured them over in your direction. I'm telling you in advance so you can forge some type of identity, and make things easier for the both of us.
units.displayText: I've lured them over in your direction. I'm telling you in advance so you can forge some type of identity, and make things easier for the both of us.

spans.text: I've lured them over in your direction. I'm telling you in advance so you can forge some type of identity, and make things easier for the both of us.

units.rawText: Oh, Kuro, I must have a special place in your heart. I was just feeling a little bit down in the dumps, but here you've sent two toys, just for me~
units.displayText: Oh, Kuro, I must have a special place in your heart. I was just feeling a little bit down in the dumps, but here you've sent two toys, just for me~

spans.text: Oh, Kuro, I must have a special place in your heart. I was just feeling a little bit down in the dumps, but here you've sent two toys, just for me~

units.rawText: Wait a second. What are you doing? I'm telling you, you're going to expose yourself.
units.displayText: Wait a second. What are you doing? I'm telling you, you're going to expose yourself.

spans.text: Wait a second. What are you doing? I'm telling you, you're going to expose yourself.

units.rawText: Hehe, I know my limits. Relax.
units.displayText: Hehe, I know my limits. Relax.

spans.text: Hehe, I know my limits. Relax.

units.rawText: I shall prepare a few surprises for our guests, then~
units.displayText: I shall prepare a few surprises for our guests, then~

spans.text: I shall prepare a few surprises for our guests, then~
